entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State.
2. The Petitioner apprehends his arrest in a case registered for the offences punishable under Sections 341, 323, 379, 504, 506, 406, 420/34 of the Indian Penal Code.

3. At the outset, learned A.P.P. for the State submits that petitioner has been declared absconder and thereafter, process of sections 82 Cr.P.C. has already been initiated against him to ensure his appearance in the Court.
4. Considering the aforesaid development, petition for pre-arrest bail of the petitioner is dismissed as not maintainable.

(Prabhat Kumar Singh, J)
